# Update on every prompt
function __lope_hook --on-event fish_prompt
    command lope add -- $PWD
end

# No-prefix directory jumping via Enter key interception
function __lope_execute
    set -l cmd (commandline -b)
    set -l first_word (string split ' ' -- $cmd)[1]

    # Skip if empty
    if test -z "$first_word"
        commandline -f execute
        return
    end

    # Skip if command exists
    if type -q "$first_word"
        commandline -f execute
        return
    end

    # Skip if starts with path characters
    if string match -qr '^[./~]' -- "$first_word"
        commandline -f execute
        return
    end

    # Check if it's a local directory (exact match)
    if test -d "$first_word"
        commandline -r "cd $first_word"
        commandline -f execute
        return
    end

    # Fuzzy match against current directory contents
    set -l result (command lope query --cwd -- $cmd 2>/dev/null)
    if test -n "$result"
        commandline -r "cd \"$result\""
        commandline -f execute
        return
    end

    # Query lope database
    set -l result (command lope query -- $cmd 2>/dev/null)
    if test -n "$result"
        commandline -r "cd \"$result\""
        commandline -f execute
        return
    end

    # Not a lope match, execute normally
    commandline -f execute
end

bind \r __lope_execute
bind \n __lope_execute

# lope hook - called after directory changes
__lope_hook() {
    command lope add -- "$PWD"
}

# Update when directory changes (chpwd hook)
[[ -n "${chpwd_functions[(r)__lope_hook]}" ]] || chpwd_functions+=(__lope_hook)

# Jump function
j() {
    if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
        builtin cd ~
    elif [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "-" ]]; then
        builtin cd -
    elif [[ $# -eq 1 && -d "$1" ]]; then
        # Explicit path - cd directly without fuzzy matching
        builtin cd -- "$1"
    else
        local result
        # Try CWD first, then database
        result=$(command lope query --cwd -- "$@" 2>/dev/null)
        if [[ -z "$result" ]]; then
            result=$(command lope query -- "$@" 2>/dev/null)
        fi
        if [[ -n "$result" ]]; then
            builtin cd -- "$result"
        else
            echo "lope: no match found" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

# Interactive mode with fzf
ji() {
    local result
    result=$(command lope query --all -- "$@" | fzf --height=40% --reverse)
    if [[ -n "$result" ]]; then
        builtin cd -- "$result"
    fi
}

# ZLE widget to intercept commands before execution
__lope_accept_line() {
    local first_word="${BUFFER%% *}"

    # Skip if buffer is empty
    if [[ -z "$BUFFER" ]]; then
        zle .accept-line
        return
    fi

    # Skip paths (starting with . / or ~)
    if [[ "$first_word" == "."* ]] || \
       [[ "$first_word" == "/"* ]] || \
       [[ "$first_word" == "~"* ]]; then
        zle .accept-line
        return
    fi

    # Skip if command exists (whence checks builtins, functions, aliases, and PATH)
    if whence "$first_word" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        zle .accept-line
        return
    fi

    # Check if it's a local directory (exact match)
    if [[ -d "$first_word" ]]; then
        BUFFER="cd ${(q)first_word}"
        zle .accept-line
        return
    fi

    # Fuzzy match against current directory contents
    local result
    result=$(command lope query --cwd -- $=BUFFER 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ -n "$result" ]]; then
        BUFFER="cd ${(q)result}"
        zle .accept-line
        return
    fi

    # Query lope database
    result=$(command lope query -- $=BUFFER 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ -n "$result" ]]; then
        BUFFER="cd ${(q)result}"
    fi

    zle .accept-line
}

zle -N accept-line __lope_accept_line
